what: C: Worlds → Saves → Resume the restored save: the public world opens for C's key as a visitor

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (s.screen === 'play' && w.status === 'ready' && (w.value.status.link === 'online' || w.value.status.error)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; return JSON.stringify(w.status === 'ready' ? { head: w.value.now.head.n, link: w.value.status.link, role: w.value.status.role, writable: w.value.status.writable, error: w.value.status.error } : w) })()
